difficulty_reason: The retained proof carries both stages in full: the final assertion is proved by splitting the empty/punctured cases, applying Local Cohomology cd-bound lemmas, reducing to the reduced complete ring with dualizing complex, then applying Lemma application-theorem to identify colimit H0 with the formal limit and deriving a contradiction from idempotents on a disconnected U cap Y; the general statement is deduced by an inductive prime-avoidance choice of f_1,...,f_e cutting Z down dimension by dimension while keeping the separating points inside.
